courses.title: 7 Steps to Healing Your Heart
courses.description: A self-paced on-demand course in seven steps that uses mindfulness, gratitude and forgiveness practices to let go of grudges and old hurt. It comes with twelve months of access and is run through Omega.

free_resources.title: Meditation for Grief and Loss
free_resources.description: Lynne tells how a run of losses first led her to meditation and offers simple ways to sit with grief, using the breath as a place to rest attention without trying to make the pain smaller.

free_resources.title: Meditation Before Sleep for Beginners
free_resources.description: A short written practice for lying in bed: soften the eyes and jaw, feel the pillow and the breath, and keep returning to those sensations when the mind runs ahead to tomorrow.
